# Henri Funk (he / him)
### PhD Candidate in Statistics · LMU Munich

I'm a PhD candidate at the **Chair of Statistics, LMU Munich**, working in
cooperation with the group of Physical Geography and Complex Environmental
Systems, and a member of the **Statistical Consulting Unit (StaBLab)**.

My research combines statistical learning with environmental and climate
data: multivariate bias correction of climate models, copula-based
post-processing, and algorithm-agnostic interpretability for clustering.

I'll be joining **BayWaT-AI**, a new project on river water temperatures and
riverine heatwaves in Bavaria, developing deep-learning models to predict
stream temperature extremes under climate change. More details on the
[Projects](projects.qmd) page.

## Research interests

- Climate modelling & bias correction
- Compound events & hydrology
- Copula-based multivariate models
- Explainable / algorithm-agnostic machine learning
- Uncertainty quantification
- River water temperatures & riverine heatwaves
